annotations.title: Cost to send crypto on each network

description: USD (and BRL) cost to send the native coin, send USDT/USDC (to a holder and to a new address) and do a swap on 12 networks: Ethereum, Base, Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Solana, Tron, TON, Bitcoin, Litecoin. Use it to answer "what is the cheapest network to send USDT".
